name: Kurogane Yuuji
source:
Height/sizes: I-I'm still growing!! (I'll be taller soon!)
His favourite food: Sherbet ice.
His disliked food: Green peas.
The subject he lectures: Chemistry.

The youngest "Eleven Master" and [url=/c2730]Hinayu[/url]'s childhood friend. Yuuji a child prodigy who has a special license to practice pharmacy, but other than that, he's just a normal kid.
